decisions.reason: A multi-model candle arch line close to the core offer and featured on the home page represents a visible, low-risk investment that management will continue.
The one-tier pyramid fits the firm's traditional Erzgebirge-style range and was promoted on the home page, so there is little reason to withdraw it after one season.

As the publicly announced flagship line with several models and substantial development investment, the electronic music box is something management will persist with, attributing any weak results to start-up effects.
The motif platform is an accessory tied to the flagship music box, so commitment to that direction carries it forward despite its low visibility.
The Christmas platform is only mentioned on the website, but it supports the committed music box system and seasonal sales can be blamed on timing, so it is retained.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds on the established craft offer and was shown on the home page, so management will keep it in the seasonal range.
